title: Plan Reach and Frequency Point
description: Cumulative reach and average frequency of the plan over a window counted from the first airing. Reach does not add across windows or slices, so it is reported here and never summed from allocations. A plan reports the windows it can: the four-week window ({interval: 28, unit: days}), the whole flight ({interval: 1, unit: campaign}), and optionally one point per week of the flight ({interval: 7, 14, 21 ... unit: days}) for reach and frequency by week.

reach.description: Estimated unduplicated audience reached within the window, in audience_basis.reach_unit.

frequency.description: Estimated average exposures per person reached within the window.
